## Details

<a id="sprite_anim_ptrs"></a>
### [`sprite_anim_ptrs`](../../../../src/sprites/sprite_anims.asm#L6) `$CC39-$CC64`

*data*

Pointers to the sprite animations $00-$15. The animation number is in $0292,x (bit 7 set).

- **Read by:** [`animate_sprite`](sprite_anim.md#animate_sprite)

<a id="sprite_anim_00"></a>
### [`sprite_anim_00`](../../../../src/sprites/sprite_anims.asm#L14) `$CC65-$CC6E`

*data*

Sprite animation: frame time, colour and flags, then sprite pointers minus $20. Flag bits: 7 multicolour, 6 wide, 5 tall. $ff and a command end it. 0 loops, 1 stops the sprite, 2 jumps to the offset that follows. 3 starts the animation that follows.

- **Entry of:** [`sprite_anim_ptrs`](../../tables.md#sprite_anim_ptrs)
